preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of magnets n for each test case must be between 3 and 2000.
The total sum of all n over all test cases must not exceed 2000.

postconditions.description: The output must be in the format '! k A' where k is the number of demagnetized magnets and A is the list of their indices.

postconditions.expression: len(A) == k and all(1 <= a <= n for a in A)
postconditions.description: The list A must contain exactly k distinct indices of demagnetized magnets, each between 1 and n.
All indices in A must correspond to demagnetized magnets of type '-'.
